payload.description_as_reported: Imagining a procedure or concept can be a more effective instructional technique than conventional studying, provided the presentation format is integrated rather than split-attention.
payload.pattern: Display the {procedure_steps} as a single integrated overlay on the primary task interface, rather than across multiple tabs or windows, once the user has initiated the first of the {procedure_steps} steps.
